crossRefs.note: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

translations.web: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
translations.bsb: A man lacking judgment strikes hands in pledge and puts up security for his neighbor.
translations.kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
translations.asv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his neighbor.
